title: Vampiro turns against Sting
summary: A former alliance becomes a feud built around Sting and Vampiro’s darker personas. Their conflict escalates from a singles match to a staged fire stunt above the arena.

chapters.title: Sting wins the singles encounter
chapters.context: The victory does not settle the conflict as Vampiro pursues a more extreme confrontation.

chapters.title: The Human Torch match
chapters.result: Vampiro wins the Human Torch match.
chapters.context: The presentation depicts Sting being set alight and falling from the screen structure. This is a staged wrestling stunt, not a literal account of an attack.
